description: This PHP source file defines the SugarMerge class responsible for handling merge operations of metadata files within the SuiteCRM upgrade system. It includes methods to merge specific module files, manage paths, log history, and perform bulk merges across modules.

classes.name: SugarMerge
classes.description: Central class that manages merging of metadata files for modules, including individual file merging, bulk operations, path management, and history logging.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes paths and merge mappings for different metadata file types.

methods.name: setLogFilePointer
methods.description: Sets a file pointer for logging merge operations.

methods.name: mergeAll
methods.description: Performs a bulk merge across all modules in the custom directory, optionally executing and saving merges.

methods.name: mergeModule
methods.description: Merges all relevant metadata files within a specific module.

methods.name: mergeFile
methods.description: Merges a single metadata file for a given module, optionally saving the result.

methods.name: createHistoryLog
methods.description: Creates a history copy of a merged custom file for potential reversion.

methods.name: getCustomPath
methods.description: Returns the path to the custom module directory.

methods.name: getNewPath
methods.description: Returns the path to the new upgrade module directory.

methods.name: getOriginalPath
methods.description: Returns the path to the original module directory.
